question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Trenchant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dull**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Trenchant"** means something that is very sharp, incisive, or forcefully effective, often used in the context of comments or arguments. (तीखा, प्रखर)

 
 
• **Example: **The critic’s **trenchant** review of the film highlighted its flaws with surgical precision.
 
 
 
• **"Dull"** refers to something that lacks sharpness or brightness, either literally or metaphorically, such as lacking intensity or excitement. (मंद, फीका)
 
 
• **Example: **The lecture was so **dull **that many students began to doze off.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Trenchant'** is **'Dull'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dull**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Insightful **(सूझ-बूझ वाला): Having or showing a deep understanding of something.

 
 
• **Example: **Her **insightful **comments during the debate impressed everyone.
 
 
 
• **Acute **(तीव्र, पैना): Extremely sharp or intense, often used to describe perceptions or conditions.
 
 
• **Example: **She has an **acute **sense of smell and can identify spices easily.
 
 
 
• **Sharp **(तेज, धारदार): Having a pointed edge or being keen in intellect or perception.
 
 
• **Example: **His **sharp **wit made him a popular speaker at events.
